mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate prolonged low-cost financing for corporate expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 6.0% signals accelerating labor market tightness, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 6.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and business investment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS rise by >2% month-over-month, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 102.0 (index) signals strong supply chain resilience and manufacturing capacity utilization, reducing input cost volatility and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during early expansion phases.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% indicates strong consumer spending momentum, directly boosting corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS rises by >0.5% month-over-month, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 0.5% signals rising price pressures that trigger preemptive monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in higher discount rates.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and increases in employment (PAYEMS) signal a synchronized labor market strengthening, which accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls >0.2% and PAYEMS rises >0.3% month-over-month, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1500.0 (thousands of units) during late-cycle expansion phases indicates sustained consumer demand for durable goods, reducing equity valuation uncertainty and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
